text_block_list.text:
During a break from my trainer duties. 
Taking a breather with a cup of coffee in 
hand...
choice_data_list: (I feel like someone's watching me...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

Looking around the area, my eyes met with 
Still in Love's.
choice_data_list: Are you on a break?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I was thinking of having some 
coffee along with my favorite sweets.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Still, what a surprise to run into you, 
Trainer. What a coincidence... Hehe.

One day after school. While looking for a 
book on sports nutrition in the library...
choice_data_list: (I feel someone watching me again...)

text_block_list.text:
Looking over, Still in Love was gazing 
intently this way with a gentle 
expression.
choice_data_list: Were you just about to do some reading?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes. My favorite author just 
released a new book, so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Are you working, Trainer? ...Please, make 
sure not to push yourself too hard...

And then, one day. As I was watching the 
students do their independent voice 
training lessons―
choice_data_list: (Someone really is watching me...!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Do you need something from me...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... that's not it. I just happened 
to spot you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Still, I must focus on my independent 
practice, mustn't I? ...Please excuse me.

True, she seems unusually unfocused for 
someone so diligent. ...Could it be—
choice_data_list: Am I bothering you by being here?
Am I bothering you by being here?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, that's not true at all, but... 
why do you ask...?
choice_data_list:
It seems having me around distracts you, 
so...

It seems you get distracted when I'm 
around, so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...Ugh. U-Um... that's...!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Was I really staring at you that 
much...?"
choice_data_list:
Well, I kept feeling someone's eyes on 
me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...S-So that's what happened...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...E-Excuse me...!
choice_data_list: (...What's the matter with Still... ?)

text_block_list.text: —A few days after that.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, I haven't seen Still 
around the academy lately...

Come to think of it, I haven't seen Still 
around the academy lately...

text_block_list.text:
Until recently, I often felt people 
looking at me, but lately, there's been 
practically none of that. It's almost as 
if they're avoiding me...

Come to think of it, a few days ago around 
this time, I ran into Still in Love right 
here...
choice_data_list: ...Maybe we'll get to meet?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer-san...
choice_data_list: You're in the corner seat today, huh

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Excuse me...!
choice_data_list: Huh!? Wait, where are you going?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Um... Somewhere out of your sight..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The other day, I caught myself staring at 
you for too long... It was terribly rude 
of me, so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I thought... if it's only going to cause 
trouble for you...

To think that was the reason you were 
troubled... And yet—
choice_data_list: It doesn't bother me at all
It doesn't bother me at all.

text_block_list.text:
By noticing her presence, we exchange 
words even in our casual daily lives—

It felt as if our bond was deepening bit 
by bit, making it a truly comforting time 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! ...You're not bothered by it... In that 
case... does that mean it isn't a 
nuisance?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Would it be permitted... if I reflected 
you in my eyes...?"
choice_data_list:
If anything, I'd rather spend that time 
with you.

If anything, I want to spend that time 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. If that is what you wish, Trainer, 
I would be delighted...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
My favorite sweets... Yes, yes. Why, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's the rich, aromatic baked 
treats, or the sweet confections that melt 
softly on the tongue—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Everything, absolutely everything... I'll 
teach you all of it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please allow me to spend this limited 
time... together with you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Coffee today, is it? ...Actually, I happen 
to have some biscuits with me. Would you 
care for some?
choice_data_list: Thank you. I really love this combination.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I often see you enjoying your 
coffee and biscuits, after all...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But I should keep staring at you in 
moderation as well. ...Fufu.
